title: a brief of exactly 801 words is rejected with the exact count
source: cli/jitso/brief.test.ts: 'fails a brief under 40 words and one over 800' (boundary)
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES B1, defect N-27). The length check counts words: whitespace-separated tokens that hold a letter, and the four heading lines of the brief add nothing. The brief ends with a line of six filler words so that the pinned count is true under the new rule. The count is 801 and the rejection says `801 words`. The oracle counts 807 and says `807 words`, so the stderr expectation FAILS on TS.
